title: Small things that add up
intro: The parts you only notice when they're missing: the stuff we keep fixing between weekly builds.

items.title: Command-first
items.body: ⌘K reaches every command: switch profiles, jump to a feed, run an action. Every binding is rebindable.

items.title: Local-first storage
items.body: Everything lands in a local SQLite database, and retention rules prune old runs and long-archived items so it never grows unbounded.

items.title: Accounts kept apart
items.body: Each GitHub account gets its own fetcher, its own response cache and its own rate-limit budget, so a busy work org can't starve your personal repos.

items.title: Actions on the item
items.body: Each item carries the actions its flow defines: launch a session, run a script, publish a message, or fill the clipboard. An action can collect input first, all from the keyboard.

items.title: Config you can diff
items.body: Feeds, filters and flows are files. Edit in the app or in your editor; commit them like any other code.

items.title: Polite polling
items.body: Conditional requests, GitHub's own poll-interval hints, and automatic backoff keep Hive well inside your API rate limits.
